rows: The whole is one, or 100%. Keep the fraction 1/4 of that whole.
scenes.memo: The whole is one, or 100%. Keep the fraction 1/4 of that whole. Multiply 1/4 by 100%: 1/4 × 100% = 25%. Check: 25 ÷ 100 = 1/4. Reverse check using the original whole 1.
scenes.misconception: Always divide by the original whole; a percentage is measured against 100 parts.
